  PROBLEM: release_split() can clear another concurrent plan run's active split reservation. The loop posts a release marker and then removes ai:split-to-project without verifying that the reservation being released belongs to this invocation.
  WHY: Two plan runs can pass the initial marker check concurrently. If one has reserved the split while the other's marker write fails, the failing run can post a release marker on a retry and remove the shared label. The active project can then become unlinked, leaving the source issue eligible for another split.
